headline: A leaking water heater can flood your floor and the water can be scalding. Shut it off now.
steps: If you smell gas, leave the house now and call SoCalGas at 1-800-427-2200 from outside.
Close the cold-water valve on the pipe above the tank: turn it clockwise until it stops.
Gas heater: turn the gas knob on the front of the tank to "Off". Electric heater: switch its breaker off.
Keep children and pets away from the water. It may be very hot.
Move boxes and rugs off the wet floor and take photos of the tank and the floor.
callWho: Call a licensed plumber today. Ask Habitat OC about repair help before you pay for a new heater.
